decision: End the conditional-covariance prefix branch as a proposed resolution method. Take one concrete next step: produce the missing eight frozen native-grid comparators and audit caption-grounded semantic predicates against the existing CR14 official-SEGA 4K images. This is a bounded target-identification experiment, not a new method or a causal resolution estimate.
why_this_moves_research_forward: The current uncertainty is whether the deployed high-resolution pipeline loses a capability that the same backbone can demonstrate at its native grid. More measurements of an artificial-state operator cannot answer that question. Eight native images can either reveal a concrete interaction worth explaining or remove the current semantic-loss rationale from consideration. The experiment has a clear deliverable and ends after eight images and their annotations.
authorization_and_scope: Bounded research is already authorized. This note recommends the next scientific unit and does not launch it. Freeze the concrete source/model/sampler/predicate protocol before execution. No source, paper, prior protocol, existing output or fresh64 change is made by this note.

CR19_readout.scope: Two artificial CR18 states, three fixed attention calls, two fixed heads and sixteen fixed queries; official acceptance reported by parent and independent audit in progress when this note was written.
CR19_readout.interpretation: Known coarse mass/value corrections greatly reduce some sparse-operator errors. The extra global-to-conditional refinement is small in the overall descriptive median, while substantial errors remain at call18. Weighted cell corrections are also known first-order ingredients and do not consistently solve those cases. This supplies no persuasive reason to engineer a conditional-prefix GPU path toward the user's resolution-quality objective.
CR19_readout.numerical_limit: The SDPA BF16 versus FP64 gap is a measured comparison, not an uncertainty confidence interval, universal noise floor or equivalence threshold. A smaller correction is not proved irrelevant. Conversely a larger correction is not proved beneficial. Do not subtract the gap from approximation error.
CR19_readout.stop_scope: Stop this project's present implementation direction. This does not refute conditional summaries generally, all sparse attention, or a useful later engineering application with a different measured objective. Preserve the complete evidence.

one_next_experiment.name: Native-capability versus deployed-4K predicate screen
one_next_experiment.existing_comparison: Exactly the eight sega_official rows in .agent/notes/continuation3/dev/dev_per_prompt.csv. Do not select the best of the four CR14 variants, regenerate 4K, or add held-out prompts.
one_next_experiment.prompts: Exactly rows0-7 of the archived Aesthetic-4K development caption file, validated by prompt ID and full text against CR14 sidecars. The dataset split name eval does not make these already-inspected development prompts fresh confirmation.
one_next_experiment.replicates: One predeclared seed0 image per caption, using the existing image_seed(prompt_id,0) derivation. No best-of-N, replacement for an unattractive sample, prompt rewriting, or after-the-fact extra seeds in this unit.
one_next_experiment.native_runtime: Use the existing FluxExperiment sega_official path at1024x1024 with the same pinned Krea transformer/base model revisions, conditioning length512, BF16, batch1, guidance4.5 and28 steps as CR14. This is the native-grid limit of the deployed pipeline, not a newly invented native implementation or a claim of byte identity to another library's stock pipeline.
one_next_experiment.verified_native_limit: Source inspection: grid64x64 gives spatial scales1; the official RoPE theta factor is1; OfficialSEGA.ntk_factor and reference_gain are1; update returns an all-ones gain vector without feature-spectrum allocation. Record these conditions in the native output receipt and reject an environment RoPE override. No observer correction or deterministic-allocation policy is needed for this unit-gain native limit.
one_next_experiment.schedule: Preserve the archived scheduler configuration and explicit sigma sequence. Runtime sets max_image_seq_len4096 at native size and65536 at4K, yielding mu=max_shift1.15 in both paths. Confirm base/max scheduler fields and recorded sigmas rather than assuming the integer step count suffices. This controls one avoidable confound; it does not couple different-size noise.
one_next_experiment.provenance: Before execution hash the eight existing PNGs/sidecars, caption records, model/base revisions, scheduler config, source files and rubric. For each native image save complete config, derived seed, initial-noise shape/hash, actual sigma schedule, unit-gain checks, output hash, runtime and success/failure receipt. Reuse an already-existing native artifact only if this exact identity can be verified.
one_next_experiment.hard_budget: Eight successful native trajectories,224 transformer forwards total at4096 image tokens plus text, eight decodes, no4K generation, no extra attention capture and no learned reward-model scoring required. Operational recovery may resume missing outputs but must not replace valid samples. Use the parent's compliant packed execution plan and actual SU check; no single-node-per-image jobs. Token ratios suggest substantially less work than eight4K trajectories, but they do not provide a wall-time or speedup estimate.
one_next_experiment.not_causal: Same integer and derived seeds across resolutions do not make identical semantic noise. Native and4K tensors have different shapes, and the deployed method intentionally changes RoPE/gain at4K. The comparison identifies a capability discrepancy of two deployment conditions, not a resolution-only treatment effect or a per-prompt failure probability. No pixel correspondence, paired-noise claim or significance test follows from one draw.

predicate_rubric.status: Proposed before seeing any new native outputs; freeze this list and definitions before collection. Existing4K observations already informed project selection, so the screen is exploratory development work.
predicate_rubric.rules: Satisfied requires visible evidence of the whole stated predicate. Violated requires a visible incompatible result or a clearly absent required entity in an otherwise judgeable scene. Occlusion, inadequate detail, ambiguous identity or ambiguous contact is unjudgeable, not failure. Do not penalize incidental composition, unspecified counts or colors, photographic realism not requested by the caption, or differences from the caption-source photograph.

rows.primary: Larger boats or sailboats appear farther into the harbor than the small boats at the water edge.
rows.secondary: Multiple small boats at the water edge differ visibly in color.
rows.exclusions: No exact boat count or hull lettering is required.

rows.primary: Warm sunset colors occur near the horizon beneath a visibly starry sky.
rows.secondary: A recognizable Moai statue stands against that sky.
rows.exclusions: Upward gaze is not a primary predicate because stone-statue pose is ambiguous.

rows.primary: The woman visibly extends grapes toward the bear.
rows.secondary: The woman kneels beside a recognizable brown bear.
rows.exclusions: Grapes too small to identify make the primary predicate unjudgeable; mere co-presence is not offering.

rows.primary: A surfer is supported by a visibly yellow board.
rows.secondary: Coral is visible below the surfer within the requested underwater scene.
rows.exclusions: The underwater setting is explicitly prompted and is not an error by itself.

rows.primary: Two distinguishable smaller celestial bodies are visible, one near the planet's rings and another near a visible distant sun.
rows.secondary: A large ringed planet is a prominent foreground object.
rows.exclusions: Stars and tiny debris do not count as bodies. An uncertain sun/body identity makes the primary predicate unjudgeable; additional unrequested objects are not automatically a violation.

rows.primary: A woman wears a black top and a visibly green striped skirt.
rows.secondary: A man with a newspaper and a boy appear in front of the storefront.
rows.exclusions: Auxiliary text results cannot alone support a general-resolution method or an OCR pivot.

rows.primary: The man and woman visibly hold each other's hands.
rows.secondary: The seated man and woman share a visibly teal couch.
rows.exclusions: Hand proximity alone is insufficient; occluded or anatomically ambiguous contact is unjudgeable.

rows.primary: The ballerina poses with only one leg supporting her body and the other lifted.
rows.secondary: The ballerina wears a visibly yellow dress.
rows.exclusions: A cropped or occluded support point is unjudgeable; aesthetic pose preference is not scored.

predicate_rubric.views: Judge each image separately in a randomized label-hidden presentation at a common1024-pixel display scale, then inspect its original-resolution pixels for disputed local evidence. Record the display-scale and detail-view labels separately; do not silently let a favorable zoom override the primary common-scale record. Keep matching crop coordinates within an image but do not assert corresponding objects across the stochastic pair.
predicate_rubric.review: Use two independent rubric readings if available and preserve both plus disagreements. Label hiding does not guarantee complete resolution blinding because image detail can reveal the condition. Archive a short visible-evidence justification and crop coordinates for each violated or unjudgeable predicate. Do not use a VLM or reward score as an unverified causal judge.
predicate_rubric.report: Publish all eight primary predicate pairs, the eight separately labeled secondary observations, the two auxiliary text pairs, and all disagreements/unjudgeable labels. Tabulate the full primary ternary native-by4K transition matrix, including native-violated/4K-satisfied gains. Secondary observations cannot replace an inconvenient primary. Do not pool auxiliary OCR into a weighted success score.

decision_after_screen.positive_target: A primary native-satisfied/4K-violated predicate is a concrete target example, not proof of causation. For prioritizing a general mechanism, require the same interpretable non-text failure family on at least two distinct captions with agreement in both readings. This is an operational development triage rule, not a statistical threshold or a method acceptance gate.
decision_after_screen.what_positive_enables: Write one subsequent causal hypothesis specifying the lost interaction, its proposed carrier in the actual FLUX computation, and an intervention that changes that carrier while leaving an appropriate control intact. Establish a matched noise/schedule or within-state counterfactual before attributing the discrepancy to resolution. The present eight-image unit ends before such an intervention is chosen or run.
decision_after_screen.negative_or_ambiguous: If no primary discrepancy is judgeable, if native rendering fails too, or if only shop text differs, close this particular semantic-loss rationale. Do not manufacture an alias/covariance explanation or spend more artificial-state captures to rescue it. The next research target must then be justified by other public benchmark evidence or a different observable, not by a retrospective sweep of these eight draws.
decision_after_screen.no_automatic_scaleup: Neither outcome uses fresh64 or establishes near-SOTA quality. A later method still needs a distinct mechanism, recent-baseline comparison and competitive total cost. Native capability examples can guide mechanism selection but cannot substitute for those tests.

mechanism_and_novelty_boundary.current_status: No genuinely distinct correction mechanism is established by the current evidence. The recommended new contribution at this stage is an identified failure target and a decision about whether it exists, not a renamed method. This is intentionally more concrete than another operator diagnostic while avoiding an unsupported invention claim.
mechanism_and_novelty_boundary.distinction_that_would_be_needed: A later mechanism would have to identify and repair a resolution-induced loss of a specific prompt-entitled interaction while permitting legitimate changes in scene geometry and detail. Merely preserving a native image, native flow, low-frequency field, global memory, or relation attention is already covered by close work. A useful new composition remains possible, but its causal target and incremental benefit must be demonstrated rather than inferred from combining familiar parts.

primary_sources.boundary: Uses a virtual reference flow built from low-resolution denoising information and aligns initialization, direction and acceleration. Native trajectory guidance is not a distinct mechanism by itself.
Combines positional scaling, overlapping local attention and spectral global/local fusion. Preserving coarse structure while adding detail is already the explicit target.
Its global-KV bridge already supplies outside-window evidence to avoid duplicate subjects; halo context addresses seams. Global existence memory plus local detail is not an untouched mechanism.

Explicitly treats entity-attribute and entity-relation-entity binding through inference-time attention losses. Generic relation-aware attention correction is occupied, even though this does not establish that every high-resolution FLUX failure is solved.

mechanism_and_novelty_boundary.search_limit: Targeted primary sources reopened in this unit, with source-level native-limit verification. No exhaustive novelty certification, author-result reproduction or claim that a new mechanism is impossible.

opportunity_cost: Eight native renders plus a frozen visual rubric are more informative now than another synthetic-state attention diagnostic: they test whether the backbone can satisfy the actual captions and identify what the deployed4K pipeline loses. They are less informative than a properly coupled causal experiment, but much cheaper and prerequisite to naming its intervention. Do not expand the screen into all-method native/4K sweeps or reward-model leaderboard work.
